sources.label: Official Rohan Sizing Guide (Women's Measuring Guide, cm and inches as printed)

audit: Old /pages/size-guides 404s; guide is /help/sizing-information/. Women's chart prints UK 8-20 with US, and bust/waist/hip in both inches and cm (printed cm used). EU removed (not printed). UK 8 84/67/90 -> 85/69/89; UK 12 92/75/98 -> 95/79/99; UK 18 110/93/116 -> 110/94/114. UK 20 added. The XS-XL letter table (XS = UK 8-10 ... XL = 18-20) overlaps sizes, so no altLabel.
